name: Yamazawa Co., Ltd.
summary: Yamazawa Co., Ltd. engages in the retail business in Japan. The company primarily operates food supermarkets. It also operates drug stores; and manufacture and supplies milk, tofu, natto, noodles, rice, and sugar beet products. As of February 2019, the company operated 65 stores comprising 43 stores in Yamagata prefecture and 22 stores in Miyagi prefecture. Yamazawa Co., Ltd. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Yamagata, Japan.
